neighbours.label: Descriptions of natural light emission and glow (bioluminescence, meteors, aurora, glowing embers) and related field phenomena, vs the same nature topics without light

Lightning bugs blinked in the tall grass as the sun went down.
Earth's magnetic field deflects charged particles streaming from the sun.
quiet: Some jellyfish sting swimmers when they are disturbed.

Certain mushrooms in the forest are poisonous to dogs.
A boulder rolled down the slope before it broke apart.
Plankton along the shore feed huge schools of small fish.
